primitiveBudget: one generated open SVG spine, five angular ports, one reply branch per changed port, and four liftable reciprocal replies
commitThreshold: a visitor must dwell on one port for 560ms, then leave it; a short glance, no departure, or immediate repeat is refused
memoryRule: the looked-at source port remains exact while a deterministic remote port gains a reply branch and the single spine segment bends; four replies compound
interactionRule: pointer movement or touch begins a look near a port; pointerleave or pointerup after the dwell threshold commits; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight selects, Enter/Space commits; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: filled pressure block, cutaway skin, and counterfield tiles -> one unfilled line-built SVG glyph with five angular ports
compositionRupture: central mass, distributed register, and apertured skin -> a single edge-to-edge diagonal syntax suspended in negative space
encounterRupture: hold-and-release, two-site handoff, and rim escape -> proximity, timed attention, and departure from one port
temporalRupture: gesture commits at release -> a gaze remains provisional until its duration is followed by absence
mediumRupture: filled compound paths and strata -> stroke-only SVG paths, open branches, and a changing cubic spine
changedRule: Attention becomes topology only after absence: a visitor's dwell arms one port, leaving lets a remote port answer, and the looked-at source remains unchanged.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one angular open SVG glyph. Each accepted departure bends one spine segment and adds a branch to a different port; four replies compound while the original looked-at ports remain exact.
falsifier: Delete if a quick glance or non-departure commits, if the source port changes, if the remote branch is only a colour/readout, if repeated looks reset or if the blind form reads as a generic route diagram.
deletionCondition: Delete v047 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish reciprocal attention-after-absence from v044-v046's skin, register, or pressure-object grammars.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
